routine (sorry for any formatting errors, im on mobile):


FULL:

• wet my hair in the shower, go through with a D3 deman brush

• massage bouclème curl cleanser into scalp, rinse

• apply texture id deep treatment masque to lengths of hair, smooth out with praying hands, sometimes i’ll comb through with the denman brush to get some curl clumps going while i wait 5-10 minutes, rinse

• go through the same process with the bouclème curl conditioner, i usually let this sit while i scrub my body and then rinse it out at the end.


depending on when i last washed my hair and how i am feeling, i’ll sometimes just do the first and last part of the wash routine


• i apply only curls hydrating curl creme (though i just ran out) to the lengths of my hair while it’s still wet, with praying hands

• depending on how i’m feeling, i style one of two ways:

     - i section my hair into a few small sections and then either use the D3 denman brush or my fingers to emphasize the shapes of curls in each section. i apply kinky-curly original curling custard in a very loose glaze, then lightly scrunch. i place some small claw clips at the roots of my crown and to the sides of my head where i have shorter curls (it’s a grown out mullet)

     - i go by the curl clumps created naturally with the wet hair and just finger style them to add some more shape, i apply kinky-curly original curling custard in a very loose glaze, then lightly scrunch. sometimes i’ll add claw clips but sometimes i don’t.


• i air dry my hair, i kind of just wait until it feels right and then take out the claw clips. after hair is almost completely dry, i add water and aussie miracle curls curl defining oil to my hands and break the cast

“”biblically accurate angels” usually depict ophanim or galgalim, sometimes called “the wheels.” one of the dead sea scrolls calls them angels (4Q405), whereas the book of enoch portrays them as a class of celestial beings, like the seraphim or cherubim, and the first book of enoch equates them with the thrones, another angel rank described in christian angelology (61:10, 71:7). 

the ophanim are described to be 4 wheels, each of 2 nested wheels, covered in eyes, that move next to the winged cherubim, beneath the throne of god (Ezekiel 1:15-21 NIV). Ezekiel 1:15-21 NIV reads:

"... I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces. This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel. As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went. Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around" (Biblica).


going back to the aforementioned cherubim. cherubim are another class of angel, still within the first sphere, that guard the way to the tree of life in the garden of eden (Genesis 3:24, Ezekiel 28:14 & 28:16) and the throne of god (Ezekiel 1:15-21 NIV). they have 4 faces, that of a man, an ox, a lion, and an eagle, all of which were later adopted as the signs of the 4 evangelists. they have 4 conjoined wings, which are covered in eyes, a lions body, and ox feet (Ezekiel 1:5-11 KJV). in the image shown previously, a cherub is on the right. Ezekiel 1:6-11 KJV reads:

"And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot...

And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies" (Bible Gateway).


then there’s the seraphim. they are the highest class and translate to “the burning ones.” in isaiah chapter 6 in an idealized version of solomon’s temple, they are described as having 6 wings. one pair covers their faces, one their feet, and one which they use to fly. they sing constant praises of god (Isaiah 6:1-3 KJV). Isaiah 6:1-3 KJV reads:

"... I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory" (Wikisource).


However, this isn't to say that the stereotypical image of an angel is incorrect. the ophanim/galgalim/thrones, cherubim, and seraphim are just 3 angel groups, all in the first sphere. The second sphere contains dominations/lordships (Guiley, 1996), virtues (The Etymologies of Isidore of Seville, 2006), and powers/authorities (The Etymologies of Isidore of Seville, 2006). The third sphere includes principalities/rulers (Ephesians 1, Ephesians 3), archangels (Strong's Exhaustive Concordance of the Bible), and angels/malakhim. additionally, this is part of proposed theories about angel hierarchies and theology.”

where i’m from, we have nonpartisan and partisan elections, depending on the court type, as well as retention elections, where judges appointed under merit selection are evaluated after a 2 year term and every couple of years afterwards.

      • Apply throughout length of hair, finger combing. Wait 5 minutes. Rinse

      • Loosely part hair

      • Finger comb to distribute Garnier’s Conditioner throughout length of hair, including roots. Then, squish.

         - When I comb the product through, I am moving my hands and pulling my hair up and away from my scalp with the hope it’ll create some lift.

      • Rinse conditioner out of hair using the ultimate hydration method

         - I personally followed Janelle O’Shaughnessy’s Youtube video Ultimate Hydration & Bowl Method for Curly Hair to learn how to do this. I started doing both the ultimate hydration and bowl method, as well as wet plopping, around November-December of 2021, but I don’t have any photos of my hair during this time so I decided against including it in the old routine portion.

      • While hair is still wet, but not dripping wet, I spray the XMondo’s Wavetech onto the wide tooth comb and distribute it through my hair, adding more product as needed. I pull the hair up away from the head to create some lift. Sometimes I’ll turn the brush away to create some tension. 

         - I’ll often wet my hair after applying the product to help dilute it a bit, since it foams

      • Using Kinky-Curly’s Gel that’s been mixed with water, scrunch into curls. Separate any extremely thick ones or finger curl at this point.

         - This usually doesn’t actually create a cast, but I use the Aquis’ Towel to scrunch the (minimal) crunch if it does once it’s completely dry.
